messages:
oncall-bot: ALERT: router-fallback-rate spike detected for dedicated pool `dedicated-eu-west-1` > 18% over 5m. Metric: router.fallback.count / router.request.count. Related symptom: traffic skewed to variant `gptx-4q-v2` and a subset of requests showing 504 from pool proxies. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/ded-router/fallbacks?orgId=1

maria: acked. paging sre-elena. @sre-elena are you oncall?

jon: I'm awake — looking. quick note: autoscaler heartbeat for pool ded-eu-1 shows desired_capacity=0 while node_count=18 in k8s. possible metric flip from pool-side exporter.

sre-elena: I'm on. Did we recently change routing policies? I see a canary of `smart-fallback: region-priority` rolled last night. Could be preferring incompatible variant in eu-west and then routing to hosted fallback which is overloaded -> loop.

infra-ian: digging into pool exporter logs. I see the capacity signal: `capacity_signal: 0.0001` for multiple routers at ~2117654000..2117654200, while the pool actually had GPUs healthy. looks like a telemetry tag mismatch (tag: region -> region_code) in the exporter rename.

jon: ok that explains wrong capacity signal -> autoscaler scaled down (or refused to scale) -> router fallback to hosted variants -> hosted overloaded -> router marks as degraded -> more fallback attempts -> blackhole pattern.

maria: concrete mitigation options: 1) disable fallback policy for ded-eu-1 temporarily (stop routing decisions that consult capacity_signal). 2) force route traffic to a known healthy pool (dedicated-eu-west-2) 3) patch exporter tag then trigger scaler reconciliation. Which is fastest?

infra-ian: fastest is 1) flip policy to `fallback: disabled` via console or runbook CLI. I can do a quick toggle. After that we should scale the pool back up manually to handle in-flight requests.

sre-elena: do it. Also need to notify CS about impacted customers. @customer-success can you list active tenants hitting ded-eu-1?

customer-success: impacted tenants: ["docsbot-inc", "searchly-app", "sandbox-tenant-42"]. All reported elevated 5xxs since ~07:02 UTC. We're reaching out to top 2 users.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2026-0427-03 severity=P1 responders=[sre-elena,john] channel=eng-runtime runbook=https://wiki.redwood/inci/route-fallback

jon: running CLI to disable fallback policy now. command:
```bash
redwoodctl routing set-policy --pool ded-eu-1 --policy fallback:disabled --reason "temporary mitigate wrong capacity signal"
```

maria: doing manual scale override to desired=20 to ensure capacity while we fix exporter:
```bash
kubectl -n redwood scale sts ded-eu-1 --replicas=20
```

infra-ian: exporter patch PR is ready, small rename fix (tag -> region_code) and bump. I'll ship to staging then prod. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/exporter/merge/2345

sre-elena: after toggle we should monitor fallback_rate and 5xx. watchlist: router.fallback.rate, pool.available_replicas, hosted.error_rate.

oncall-bot: ACTION: policy toggled by jon at 2117654389. Autoscaler still reconciling; manual replica override applied by maria at 2117654405.

jon: immediate numbers after toggle: fallback_rate dropped from 18.4% -> 3.2% within 90s. hosted.error_rate decreased from 12% -> 4.1%. pool available_replicas now 20.

customer-success: customers reporting partial recovery, will keep CS thread open.

sre-elena: ok next steps: 1) promote exporter patch to prod (infra-ian) 2) roll autoscaler reconciliation and verify capacity_signal matches actual nodes 3) re-enable smart-fallback with guard (min_capacity_threshold=0.2 and prefer-region fallback order) 4) postmortem and runbook add.

infra-ian: patch promoted at 2117654670, metrics now show capacity_signal ~0.95 for healthy pools. Autoscaler reconciled and set desired 18 again at 2117654802.

jon: re-enabled fallback with stricter guard at 2117654900:
```bash
redwoodctl routing set-policy --pool ded-eu-1 --policy "smart-fallback{min_capacity=0.2,order=[region,variant,hosted]}"
```

sre-elena: monitoring for 20m. If no regressions we'll close incident and start postmortem. Please add timeline and decisions to the incident ticket.

maria: quick customer impact summary for ticket: - window: 07:02-07:12 UTC - affected tenants: docsbot-inc (high), searchly-app (med), sandbox-tenant-42 (low) - user-visible: increased 5xxs and latency, temporary failover to hosted for some requests - mitigation: disabled fallback policy, manual scale, exporter patch, re-enable with guard.

customer-success: CS notes added and customers updated. docsbot-inc asked for RCA asap and slack bridge created.

sre-elena: handing off to infra-ian for follow-up and postmortem doc. I'll remain as incident lead for writeup. Next oncall please monitor fallback_rate alert for the next 24h.

maria: ack handoff. Leaving channel. :wave:

oncall-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status=mitigated, severity=P1 -> monitoring. Incident will be closed after postmortem posted.

sre-elena: Postmortem actions (to add to ticket): 1) add exporter telemetry schema guard in CI 2) add automated fallback-policy kill-switch for immediate toggles 3) add a canary that verifies capacity_signal before autoscaler reacts 4) run a tabletop with CS on customer communication cadence.

infra-ian: noted. I'll write the infra patch summary and link to PR logs in the incident ticket.

jon: final check: routing logs show no remaining blackhole patterns. closing active page.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED: INC-2026-0427-03 closed_by=sre-elena closed_at=2117655221
